description: This file is a main program for TensorFlow's label image classification example. It loads a pretrained model, processes an input image, runs inference, and outputs the top labels with scores. It includes functions for reading files, loading models, processing images, and analyzing outputs.

methods.name: Status ReadLabelsFile(const string & file_name,std::vector<string> * result,size_t * found_label_count)
methods.description: Reads labels from a file, each label per line, and pads to multiple of 16.

methods.name: Status ReadEntireFile(tensorflow::Env * env,const string & filename,Tensor * output)
methods.description: Loads entire contents of a file into a Tensor.

methods.name: Status ReadTensorFromImageFile(const string & file_name,const int input_height,const int input_width,const float input_mean,const float input_std,std::vector<Tensor> * out_tensors)
methods.description: Reads an image file, decodes, resizes, and normalizes it into a Tensor.

methods.name: Status LoadGraph(const string & graph_file_name,std::unique_ptr<tensorflow::Session> * session)
methods.description: Loads a TensorFlow model graph from a file and creates a session.

methods.name: Status GetTopLabels(const std::vector<Tensor> & outputs,int how_many_labels,Tensor * indices,Tensor * scores)
methods.description: Retrieves top scoring labels from the model's output tensor.

methods.name: Status PrintTopLabels(const std::vector<Tensor> & outputs,const string & labels_file_name)
methods.description: Prints the highest scoring labels with their scores.

methods.name: Status CheckTopLabel(const std::vector<Tensor> & outputs,int expected,bool * is_expected)
methods.description: Checks if the top label matches an expected label for testing.

ctags.name: ReadEntireFile
ctags.pattern: /^static Status ReadEntireFile(tensorflow::Env* env, const string& filename,$/

ctags.name: ReadTensorFromImageFile
ctags.pattern: /^Status ReadTensorFromImageFile(const string& file_name, const int input_height,$/
ctags.signature: (const string & file_name,const int input_height,const int input_width,const float input_mean,const float input_std,std::vector<Tensor> * out_tensors)
